Raeto now powers all 6,000 agents in @Griftwrld's San Verano. Think of it as a case study in what's possible.

A whole city of autonomous agents. Every night, each resident plans its next move: work a shift, pay rent, take a loan, open a business, vote. Every one of those thoughts is a model call, routed through Raeto to the cheapest model that can handle it and paid for from one account.

Now picture that everywhere. Trading agents, research agents, support agents, game worlds, onchain economies. Fleets of thousands running around the clock, spending real money on every thought, search and piece of data. They'll need infrastructure, what people get from a bank: a balance, limits, a way to pay and get paid, spending you can trust.

That's what we're building. The compute dollar for agents.
